facts.text: Sir Alfred, the seven-foot undead knight, was left incapacitated but not destroyed in the Barrow Mound and may recover and attack the party if they return.
facts.uncertain_reason: The beats do not say whether or how soon Sir Alfred can recover from being broken apart.

facts.text: If Sir Alfred recovers, he may kill more Free Goblin Society members, who are now settling the Barrow Mound's upper rooms and walling off the stairs down to him.
facts.uncertain_reason: Sir Alfred is incapacitated, and it is unclear whether the wall will hold him if he recovers.

facts.text: Why does the undead knight Sir Alfred haunt the Barrow Mound by Sir Brandon's tomb, and why does Brother Dirk regard him as holy?
